title: Create an access token with username/password (legacy)
markdown:
For AI agents: the docs index is at https://docs.mesh.complyadvantage.com/llms.txt. Append .md to any documentation page URL to get its markdown version.

password

string

required

[Skip link to password](https://docs.mesh.complyadvantage.com/reference/createtoken#body-params-password)

The password of the API user

realm

string

required

[Skip link to realm](https://docs.mesh.complyadvantage.com/reference/createtoken#body-params-realm)

This will have been provided by ComplyAdvantage at onboarding. Note this is case sensitive.

username

string

required

[Skip link to username](https://docs.mesh.complyadvantage.com/reference/createtoken#body-params-username)

The username (email address) of the API user
